# Note: original script uses train.py but repo only has run.py
python run.py --do_train \
    --data_dir dataset/docred \
    --transformer_type roberta \
    --model_name_or_path roberta-large \
    --display_name dreeam_student_selftrain \
    --train_file train_distant.json \
    --dev_file dev.json \
    --teacher_sig_path ${TEACHER_DIR} \
    --save_path ${STUDENT_SAVE} \
    --train_batch_size 4 \
    --test_batch_size 8 \
    --gradient_accumulation_steps 2 \
    --evaluation_steps 5000 \
    --num_labels 4 \
    --lr_transformer 1e-5 \
    --lr_added 5e-5 \
    --max_grad_norm 5.0 \
    --evi_thresh 0.2 \
    --attn_lambda 1.0 \
    --warmup_ratio 0.06 \
    --num_train_epochs 5.0 \
    --seed 66 \
    --num_class 97

echo "Student training complete. $(date)"
STUDENT_CKPT=$(ls -td ${STUDENT_SAVE}/*/ | head -1)
echo "Student checkpoint: ${STUDENT_CKPT}"

# ========== Step 4: Fine-tune student on annotated data ==========
echo "=== Step 4: Fine-tune student ==="
echo "Start: $(date)"

python run.py --do_train \
    --data_dir dataset/docred \
    --transformer_type roberta \
    --model_name_or_path roberta-large \
    --display_name dreeam_student_finetune \
    --train_file train_annotated.json \
    --dev_file dev.json \
    --save_path ${FINETUNE_SAVE} \
    --load_path ${STUDENT_CKPT} \
    --train_batch_size 4 \
    --test_batch_size 8 \
    --gradient_accumulation_steps 1 \
    --num_labels 4 \
    --lr_transformer 1e-6 \
    --lr_added 3e-6 \
    --max_grad_norm 2.0 \
    --evi_thresh 0.2 \
    --evi_lambda 0.1 \
    --warmup_ratio 0.1 \
    --num_train_epochs 10.0 \
    --seed 66 \
    --num_class 97

echo "Fine-tuning complete. $(date)"
FINETUNE_CKPT=$(ls -td ${FINETUNE_SAVE}/*/ | head -1)
echo "Fine-tuned checkpoint: ${FINETUNE_CKPT}"

# ========== Step 5: Final eval with ISF ==========
echo "=== Step 5: Final evaluation (single) ==="
python run.py --data_dir dataset/docred \
    --transformer_type roberta \
    --model_name_or_path roberta-large \
    --display_name dreeam_student_eval \
    --load_path ${FINETUNE_CKPT} \
    --eval_mode single \
    --test_file dev.json \
    --test_batch_size 8 \
    --num_labels 4 \
    --evi_thresh 0.2 \
    --num_class 97

echo "=== Step 5: Final evaluation (fusion) ==="
python run.py --data_dir dataset/docred \
    --transformer_type roberta \
    --model_name_or_path roberta-large \
    --display_name dreeam_student_eval_fused \
    --load_path ${FINETUNE_CKPT} \
    --eval_mode fushion \
    --test_file dev.json \
    --test_batch_size 8 \
    --num_labels 4 \
    --evi_thresh 0.2 \
    --num_class 97

echo "=== ALL DONE at $(date) ==="
echo "Final results in: ${FINETUNE_CKPT}"
ls -la ${FINETUNE_CKPT}
SCRIPT
